svg.title: CN105 to ESP32 wiring via a bidirectional level shifter (XIAO ESP32-C6 example)
svg.desc: CN105 pin 2 GND to shifter GND (HV side); pin 3 5V to shifter HV and XIAO 5V; pin 4 TX to HV2, LV2 to XIAO D6 (GPIO16, UART RX); XIAO D7 (GPIO17, UART TX) to LV1, HV1 to CN105 pin 5 RX; XIAO 3V3 to shifter LV; XIAO GND to shifter GND (LV side); CN105 pin 1 12V not connected.
svg.text: Example build: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C6 + 4-channel BSS138 bidirectional level shifter, powered from the CN105 5 V pin
TX and RX are crossed: ESP32 TX → CN105 RX (pin 5), and CN105 TX (pin 4) → ESP32 RX.
Seeed's XIAO pinout labels D6 as TX and D7 as RX. This wiring uses GPIO17 (D7) as TX and GPIO16
(D6) as RX to match the README YAML. Other GPIOs work too if the YAML matches.
Leave pin 1 (12 V) unconnected. Pigtail wire colours vary between suppliers: go by pin position, not colour.
The XIAO 5V pin is tied to USB VBUS: disconnect CN105 before plugging in USB, or add a Schottky diode
in series with the 5 V feed.
